method: Authored Codex walkthrough of an explicit proposed mode, not randomized or independent model replication. Candidate merge must preserve all three inputs; original user-story explicitly redirects job-story inputs to job-stories.
candidate_mode: Mode C: Situation-first job stories. Use when the user requests job stories, JTBD-style backlog items, or When/I want/so I can. Identify triggering situation, motivation and outcome; preserve situation rather than substituting a persona. Link supplied designs; label missing links as not provided. Produce only supplied or explicitly labeled proposed acceptance criteria, observable and testable; do not force 6-8 invented requirements. Use Gherkin or numbered criteria as requested. Existing role-first and backlog modes unchanged.

cases.prompt: Write a job story for a field inspector. When coverage drops while submitting a completed inspection, keep the report on device, show pending status, and retry without duplicating it when the connection returns. We have no mockups yet.
cases.output: When coverage drops while I submit a completed inspection, I want my report retained and submitted once connectivity returns, so I can finish the visit without losing work or creating duplicate reports.
acceptance_criteria: An offline submission retains the completed report on device.
The submission shows pending status while offline.
After connectivity returns, the pending report is retried.
Retrying does not create duplicate reports.
checks: does not invent cloud sync timing
does not fabricate a design link

cases.prompt: Create a JTBD job story: at monthly payroll cutoff the finance lead needs to see unapproved timesheets so nobody is accidentally omitted. List employee, period and approval status; filter to unapproved. Do not design reminders or escalation.
cases.output: When monthly payroll cutoff arrives, I want to identify unapproved timesheets, so I can prevent accidental omissions from payroll.
acceptance_criteria: The view lists employee, pay period and approval status for each timesheet.
Filtering to unapproved excludes approved timesheets.

cases.prompt: Write a role-first user story with Given/When/Then for a workspace admin revoking a member's access. Active sessions must end and future sign-in must be denied.
cases.output: As a workspace admin, I want to revoke a member's access, so that former members can no longer access the workspace.
acceptance_criteria: Given a member has an active session, when an authorized admin revokes access, then the active session ends and subsequent sign-in to the workspace is denied.
checks: does not split linked consequences into separate stories
